d: Janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha ne midiya se batchit karte hue bihar aur rashtriy rajniti se jure kaee pramukh muddon par apni pratikriya di hai. apne bayan men unhonne pradhanmantri narendr modi dvara nitish setu ke udghatan karyakram se lekar vipaksh ke netaon ki haliya tippaniyon par parti ka paksh rakha.
